strategies.name: Vanilla Zero-Build + JSON Rule Templates + Node Unit Tests
strategies.summary: Plain static HTML/CSS + browser ESM with no framework or build. Expand engine scores wishes against JSON templates with {{slot}} placeholders and returns ExpandResult; chain templates include steps[]. Tests import engine.js via Node node:test.
strategies.stack: vanilla HTML/CSS/ESM, JSON templates, node:test, GitHub Pages static
strategies.differentiator: Lowest dependency: zero-build, declarative JSON templates, Node-only tests (no browser runner).

strategies.name: Preact + Vite + JS-Module Templates + Vitest & Playwright
strategies.summary: Preact components with Vite build; templates are JS modules exporting build(userMessage)->PromptArtifact with real conditionals; classify/registry picks intent. Dual test layers: Vitest for engine structure, Playwright E2E for copy buttons and chain UI.
strategies.stack: Preact, Vite, Vitest, Playwright, JS module templates
strategies.differentiator: Framework + build + executable templates + real browser E2E covering copy/chain UX.

strategies.name: Lit Web Components + Zero-Build ESM + Custom Template DSL + Browser Test Runner
strategies.summary: Lit custom elements via import map (CDN or vendored), zero local bundler. Templates are .tmpl files with {{slot}} and lightweight {{#if}} conditionals parsed by a small hand-rolled DSL. @web/test-runner exercises parser and shadow DOM in a real browser.
strategies.differentiator: Platform Web Components + bespoke declarative DSL (between flat JSON and full JS) + unified in-browser tests.
